channel.title: Olive Oil Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Olive Oil Times (oliveoiltimes.com)

item.title: New Olive Groves Take Root in Italy’s Northern Regions of Piedmont, Trentino
item.description: Olive cultivation is expanding across northern Italy, driven by a mix of shifting climate conditions, farm diversification and renewed interest in local production.

item.title: World Olive Oil Competition 2026 Live Updates
item.description: The world’s most prestigious olive oil quality contest is revealing award winners in the Northern Hemisphere division. We are following the results live.

item.title: Students Use Podcast to Preserve Heritage of Karaburun’s Date Olives
item.description: In the Karaburun Peninsula, students are using audio storytelling to connect climate change, rural depopulation and intergenerational knowledge to the future of the region’s distinctive date olives.

item.title: Trade Group Tightens Standards for Certified Seal Program
item.description: The North American Olive Oil Association has introduced stricter standards for its Certified Seal program, including tighter chemical limits, shorter shelf-life parameters and expanded supply chain...

item.title: E.U. Adopts 2040 Climate Target
item.description: European Union member states have approved a 2040 climate target requiring emissions to fall 90 percent from 1990 levels, with most of the cuts expected to come from within the bloc.

item.title: How Rio Grande do Sul Became the Center of Brazil’s Olive Oil Industry
item.description: From roadside shops and theme parks to guided harvests and tastings, producers in Rio Grande do Sul are using tourism and diversification to build Brazil’s olive oil industry.

item.title: New Research Suggests Olives May Reveal Oil Quality Before Milling
item.description: A new study suggests that analyzing the metabolic profile of olives before extraction could help predict some of the chemical and sensory characteristics of the oil they will produce.

item.title: Report Finds Rising Interest in Olive Oil Tourism Amid Knowledge Gap in Italy
item.description: Olive oil tourism in Italy grew sharply between 2021 and 2024, but a new report shows most consumers still cannot name a single olive cultivar.

item.title: Olive Growing Returns to Italy’s Smallest Region
item.description: Olive cultivation is slowly expanding in Valle d’Aosta as growers reclaim abandoned terraces, adapt to milder conditions and plan for the area’s first mill.

item.title: Award-Winning Olive Oil Anchors a Slower Way of Life on Lefkada
item.description: On the Greek island of Lefkada, Andreas Dimitrakopoulos has transformed a neglected family grove into an award-winning olive oil farm that also offers tastings, cooking classes and slow-food dining.
